e.title: IAA AI-Augmented Underwriting
e.summary: IAA 文章：寿险健康险 AI 增强核保——收益与风险平衡
e.body:
IAA（国际精算协会）资源文章「AI-Augmented Underwriting in Life-Health Insurance: Balancing Benefits and Risks」：寿险/健康险中 AI 增强核保的收益（效率/一致性）与风险（公平性/监管）平衡。对 RIAA：核保 AI 的官方视角——理解 AI 核保的「好与坏」（与 [[actuarial-ai-case-studies]] 的 IAA 案例系列同源）；收益-风险框架衔接 AI 治理（[[aae-ai-act-position]] 的监管立场）；核保场景（[[aws-underwriting-workbench]] 工具）的方法论背景；保险 AI 伦理/合规谈资。

## 同类工具

e.body_en:
The IAA (International Actuarial Association) resource article 'AI-Augmented Underwriting in Life-Health Insurance: Balancing Benefits and Risks': the benefits (efficiency/consistency) and risks (fairness/regulation) of AI-augmented underwriting in life/health insurance. For RIAA: the official view of underwriting AI — understanding the good-and-bad of AI underwriting (sharing roots with [[actuarial-ai-case-studies]]); the benefit-risk framework connects to AI governance (the regulatory stance of [[aae-ai-act-position]]); methodological background for the underwriting scenario (tool [[aws-underwriting-workbench]]); talking points for insurance-AI ethics/compliance.
